contract.goal: one report covering the whole platform's coverage, built on instrumentation that every module gets by inheritance rather than by remembering to opt in
contract.output: jacoco enabled in the root POM's active plugins; 20 redundant per-module declarations removed; new build/jacoco-aggregate module depending on all 27 jar modules and binding report-aggregate to verify
constraints: no coverage threshold is introduced anywhere - the aggregate reports, the existing per-service gate enforces
no module's own jacoco configuration or thresholds change
ludwig-service-parent's configured jacoco declaration is not touched
the aggregator must not appear in any module's inRepoDependents, or every narrow gate becomes a full-reactor build
the aggregator publishes nothing and is not added to ludwig-bom
assert on report CONTENT, not on the build being green - an empty report builds green
done_when: aggregate XML names all 27 jar modules and the 5 previously-uninstrumented ones have non-zero instruction counts

decisions: activation moves to the root rather than adding the plugin to the 5 modules missing it: opting in per module is the defect, and fixing it per module leaves the trap armed for module thirty

dataFileIncludes is left at its default (every *.exec in target/). Services produce three exec files and loading all three is not double-counting - JaCoCo merges by class id and ORs probe arrays - so an explicit list would only be another thing to keep in step with ludwig-service-parent's merge config
no repository-wide threshold: it would fail on day one and the response would be to lower it until it passed

the content check initially failed on checkstyle-rules, reporting 0 instructions as an uninstrumented module. That was the check being wrong, not the build: checkstyle-rules is a resources-only jar with no .java at all, so zero is the correct answer. The check now separates 'no code to measure' from 'code that was not measured' - conflating them makes it cry wolf on its first run, which is how a check gets deleted.
removing the 20 bare declarations left two modules (hot-reload, odata-filter) with an empty <build><plugins></plugins></build>; both were removed since the jacoco entry had been their only content.
check_aggregate_report.py is wired into gate.sh only on the full-reactor path, because a narrow gate does not regenerate the report and would check a stale one.
